treaty_name: Convention between the Government of Canada and the Government of the Republic of Moldova for the Avoidance of Double Taxation and the Prevention of Fiscal Evasion with respect to Taxes on Income (2002, with Protocol)
eif_quote: Canada-Moldova Tax Convention Act, 2002: "[Note: Convention and Protocol in force December 13, 2002, see Canada Gazette Part I, Volume 137, page 400.]"
source_title: Canada-Moldova Tax Convention Act, 2002 (S.C. 2002, c. 24, Part 4), Schedules 1-2 - Convention and Protocol (Justice Laws consolidated text)

rates.quote: (a) 5 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends if the beneficial owner is a company that controls directly or indirectly at least 25 per cent of the voting power in the company paying the dividends; and
(b) 15 per cent of the gross amount of the dividends in all other cases.

2 However, such interest may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which it arises and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the interest is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the interest.

2 However, such royalties may also be taxed in the Contracting State in which they arise and according to the laws of that State, but if the beneficial owner of the royalties is a resident of the other Contracting State, the tax so charged shall not exceed 10 per cent of the gross amount of the royalties.

ppt.basis: n/a (no MLI; treaty has no PPT clause)

notes: Art. 27(a): effective for taxes withheld at source on amounts paid or credited on or after 1 January of the year following entry into force (EIF 2002-12-13 -> 2003-01-01). Dividend 5% tier: company that "controls directly or indirectly at least 25 per cent of the voting power" (voting test recorded as ownership_threshold 25). Not modelled: Art. 11(3) exemptions (government debt interest; interest to tax-exempt pension organisations). Protocol para. 7 excludes from the Convention non-resident-owned companies/trusts/partnerships benefiting from substantially lower tax. MLI: Moldova is not an MLI signatory, so no PPT.
